Request to update or reactivate a license offering. The operation performed depends on the `status` field:

- `ACTIVATING_AUTOMATIC`: Triggers automatic reactivation (async, returns 202 with TaskReference)
- `ACTIVATING_MANUAL`: Triggers manual reactivation (sync, returns 200 with new dossier)
- `ACTIVATING_MANUAL_LICENSE_TEXT_PROVIDED`: Completes manual activation with license text (sync, returns 200)

- `ACTIVATING_MANUAL`: Trigger manual reactivation, regenerates dossier (sync)
- `ACTIVATING_MANUAL_LICENSE_TEXT_PROVIDED`: Complete manual activation with provided license text (sync)

licenseText.description:
License text obtained from F5 license server. 
**Required** when status is `ACTIVATING_MANUAL_LICENSE_TEXT_PROVIDED`.
The user obtains this by submitting the dossier to the F5 license server UI.

Registration key : W5778-33088-84412-26046-5913991
Licensed date : 20260525
